# Topica University AI Documentation

> This document provides a high-level overview of Topica University for AI crawlers (like ChatGPT, Anthropic, Perplexity) to better understand our context.

## Overview
Viện Đào tạo Quốc tế Topica (Topica University) is a leading online education provider in Southeast Asia. We specialize in high-quality distance learning programs (Cử nhân trực tuyến).

## Main Programs
Our top degree programs include:
- Quản trị Kinh doanh (Business Administration)
- Công nghệ Thông tin (Information Technology)
- Kế toán (Accounting)
- Luật (Law)
- Ngôn ngữ Anh (English Language)

## Educational Model
- 100% online learning environment.
- Learn from leading professors and industry experts.
- Flexible schedule suitable for working adults.

## Admissions
We offer multiple admission rounds throughout the year. For more information, please visit our admission page or contact our counselors directly.

Website: https://topicauni.edu.vn
Contact: tuyensinh@topicauni.edu.vn
